description: This Dart source file implements a minimal WebSocket client for a Flutter mobile application, managing connection lifecycle, heartbeat ping, auto-reconnect with jitter backoff, session resumption, and message handling.

classes.name: WsClient
classes.description: A minimal WebSocket client managing connection, heartbeat, auto-reconnect, session resume, and message streaming for a Flutter app.

methods.name: WsClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket client with a token store and optional reconnect policy.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Stream emitting decoded JSON messages received from the WebSocket.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Boolean indicating whether the WebSocket is currently connected.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a WebSocket URI with optional token and session ID query parameters.

methods.name: _startHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts periodic ping messages to keep the connection alive.

methods.name: _connectOnce
methods.description: Establishes a single WebSocket connection, sets up message listening, and requests resume.

methods.name: _scheduleReconnect
methods.description: Schedules an attempt to reconnect with jittered delay using retry policy.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Public method to initiate connection, handling automatic reconnection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Public method to disconnect and stop reconnection attempts.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a JSON-encoded payload over the WebSocket.

methods.name: joinLobby
methods.description: Placeholder method to join a lobby by lobby ID.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Releases resources by disconnecting and closing message stream.
